answer_summary: L is 6^1,6^4-di-O-debenzylated per-O-benzyl β-cyclodextrin. On the β-CD template (units numbered 1-7 as printed on page Q9-3): primary boxes = CH2OH (unit 1), CH2OBn (unit 2), CH2OBn (unit 3), CH2OH (unit 4), CH2OBn (unit 5), CH2OBn (unit 6), CH2OBn (unit 7); secondary-face box = (OBn)14. Reasoning: NaH (30 equiv.)/BnCl (30 equiv.) exhaustively benzylates all 21 OH (30 >= 7 primary + 14 secondary); 2 equiv. of DIBAL-H then performs exactly two primary reductive debenzylations - the first on the C7-symmetric perbenzylated ring, conventionally anchored at unit 1, and the second directed by the now-protic unit 1 to unit 4 per the problem-stated Sinay rule (unit 4 available, so the unit-3 fallback never fires; the rule provably excludes units 2,3,5,6,7). The two free primary OHs are exactly what the printed dimer requires downstream: one is allylated (t-BuOK, allyl bromide), olefin-metathesised (Grubbs I) and hydrogenated (H2/PtO2) into the -CH2O(CH2)4OCH2- tether, the other remains as the dimer's single free CH2OH. Molecular formula of L: C175H184O35 (= C42H70O35 + 19 x C7H6); 19 benzyl groups, 2 free primary OH, 0 free secondary OH.
assumptions: problem_stated: beta-CD = 7 alpha-D-glucopyranoside units, alpha-1,4-linked (Q9-1 text); 7 primary CH2OH boxes and face box (OH)14 (Q9-1/Q9-3 figures)
problem_stated: 9.5 reagents 1) NaH (30 equiv.), BnCl (30 equiv.); 2) DIBAL-H (2 equiv.) with 'equiv. = equivalent' per mole of beta-CD (Q9-2/Q9-3)
problem_stated: Sinay rule quoted verbatim in the Q9-3 preamble (protic group at unit 1 directs next primary debenzylation to unit 4, else unit 3)
problem_stated: dimer connectivity below L (one free CH2OH, five CH2OBn, one tethered CH2O-, (OBn)14 per ring; allyl bromide drawn) used only as a consistency check, not as the answer
trusted_general_law: Williamson etherification converts OH to OBn under NaH/BnCl in excess
trusted_general_law: DIBAL-H reductively debenzylates primary O-benzyl ethers selectively over secondary ones; substoichiometric equivalents (2 < 7) cannot cleave all primary sites
trusted_general_law: t-BuOK/allyl bromide allylates only a free OH; Grubbs I + H2/PtO2 convert diallyl ethers to the saturated -(CH2)4- tether

convention: on the C7-symmetric perbenzylated ring the first undirected debenzylation site is labelled unit 1 - the numbering anchor of the preamble/answer sheet; the C7 rotational symmetry of that choice is proved in lTemplate_d7_fixed
